overviewPage.newImagesDetail: Images first reported on in each of the last 12 weeks.
overviewPage.evidenceDetail: How many images CI reported each kind of evidence for.
overviewPage.recentDetail: The newest images and what the policy says about them.
overviewPage.topPackagesDetail: Open one to see every image that contains it.

imagesPage.whatThePolicyHasAgainst: What the policy has against it
imagesPage.imagesEachRuleDenies: Images each rule denies, without what an exception waives. One image can count for two rules.
imagesPage.theLicencesMostPackagesCarry: The licences most packages carry, over every image. Red: the policy denies it; amber: unknown.
imagesPage.judgedByThePolicyOf: Judged by the policy of the moment. Ask the same question from a webhook with GET /api/v1/images/check.

exceptionDialog.theImageIsAllowedAgain: The image is allowed again until the exception ends, and the answer says it is waived. Say why, for the next review.
exceptionDialog.whyItIsAcceptableFor: Why it is acceptable, for the next review.

imagePage.whatThePolicyHasAgainst: What the policy has against it
imagePage.allOfItIsWaived: All of it is waived by an exception that has not ended.
imagePage.fixTheEvidenceInCi: Fix the evidence in CI, change the policy, or waive a rule with an exception.
imagePage.whatCiReportedThisProduct: What CI reported. This product records it and does not verify signatures or provenance itself.
imagePage.everyLicenceInTheSbom: Every licence in the SBOM, as the policy judges it.
imagePage.noSbomHasBeenStored: No SBOM has been stored for this image.
imagePage.removesTheImageWithIts: Removes the image with its SBOM and packages. CI reports it again on its next build.
imagePage.anAdmissionCheckForThis: An admission check for this digest is denied until CI reports it again.

packagesPage.whichImagesContainAPackage: Which images contain a package, in every stored SBOM. Use it the day a library turns out to be vulnerable.
packagesPage.theNameExactlySuchAs: The name, exactly, such as openssl.
packagesPage.nothingMatchesThisNameAnd: Nothing matches this name and version.

policyPage.whatEveryImageMustShow: What every image must show before it may run. It applies to all images at once, and the answer to a webhook follows it the moment it changes.
policyPage.ciRunsCosignVerifyAnd: CI runs cosign verify and reports the result; this product records it.
policyPage.spdxIdsAnOrExpression: SPDX ids. An OR expression passes when one alternative does; an AND needs every part. With an allow list, a package whose licence nobody named is denied.
policyPage.oneRegularExpressionPerLine: One regular expression per line. The signer's identity must match one. Empty: any identity.
policyPage.oneExactIssuerPerLine: One exact issuer per line, such as https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com. Empty: any issuer.
policyPage.oneIdPerLineAllow: One id per line. Empty: any licence that is not denied.
policyPage.oneIdPerLineDeny: One id per line, such as AGPL-3.0-only.

exceptionsPage.aRuleWaivedForAn: A rule waived for an image, with a reason and an end. Add one from an image's page.
exceptionsPage.everyRuleAppliesToEvery: Every rule applies to every image.

setupPage.ciReportsWhatItKnows: CI reports what it knows about each image it builds. The policy decides which may run, and a webhook or pipeline asks.
setupPage.useSupplyChainIngestToken: Use SUPPLY_CHAIN_INGEST_TOKEN, set where supply-chain runs, or an API token with the editor role from API tokens.
setupPage.fromAnAdmissionWebhookOr: From an admission webhook or a pipeline. An image nobody reported on is denied.
setupPage.whatThisProductDoesAnd: What this product does and does not do
setupPage.itRecordsTheSbomThe: It records the SBOM, the signature result and the provenance summary that CI sends, and judges them against the policy.
setupPage.itDoesNotVerifySignatures: It does not verify signatures or provenance itself yet. Whoever holds the ingest token is trusted like the pipeline that runs cosign.

welcomePage.reportAnImageFromCi: Report an image from CI, then ask whether it may run.

settingsPage.askAnAdminOfThis: Ask an admin of this supply-chain for access.
